items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: Les, I don't know all this because before the, before I went to school.

ctx.x: When was it then that you got the phonograph and started listening to the records?

Les, I don't know all this because before the, before I went to school. Between the period there from when I was four to six primarily was filled with musical activity. As soon as I started playing, they would carry me around to camp meetings in the summer. And have, so, so, you're going to play florid arpeggio versions of old, those two page hymns, Awakening Chorus and All Hail Emmanuel. The hymns in the Protestant hymn book there with many razzle dazzle scale pages up and down the keyboard from four and five…
You got the phonograph record right after you started playing the piano roll.
